today: Three lodges on more than 10,000 ha, all off-grid
Wi-Fi is listed at Stoneyvale; none is published for Mountain Retreat or Uniondale
Hunting parties spread across the estate, away from the lodges
context: Fort Governor's runs three off-grid lodges and walk-and-stalk hunting across more than 10,000 ha. Communications have to reach the field as well as the lodges. We propose one small owned backbone for the estate.
security_note: Hunting parties in the field, staff at three lodges and a need to reach someone quickly if something goes wrong. One network that covers the lodges and the main hunting areas makes that dependable.
